description: This Java class defines a data structure representing password credentials for a device, including a list of password secrets used for authentication. It extends a common credential class and provides methods to access and set the secrets, with validation to prevent empty lists. The class is part of an API related to device credential management in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: PasswordCredential
classes.description: A credential type for storing a password for a device, including a list of password secrets used for authentication, with validation and fluent setters.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of password secrets associated with this credential.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of password secrets, with validation to prevent empty lists.
